notes: Independent primary author project table, matched by Project.URL, title, replicated study number, and effect description. Values are author-supplied/author-derived; no statistic was calculated or converted. N.O and N.R are named sample N fields; analytic sample role and exclusions are undocumented in this table. Underscores and other damaged metric glyphs are retained exactly as supplied in the CSV. Replicated.study.number.R identifies the original experiment replicated, rather than the replication report study number. Known locator mismatch: assigned outcome is discrimination of AX and BX after AX/BX versus AX/BY intermixed preexposure; primary project row instead specifies AX (or BX) versus CX trial performance. Table values are retained as the actually located test, target_match=false; do not merge them with the requested contrast. Reported success is the authors' verdict for the located project-table effect, which differs from the assigned contrast/outcome; it is not a verdict established for the requested target. The mismatching-effect table verdict is quoted for provenance only; reported_success.value is null for the requested target.
